observation: A real installed-consumer replay in voku/simple-php-code-parser (commit 93867be) asked for AST-from-string support, whose decisive evidence is the already-shipped PhpCodeParser::getAstFromString(). agent-map indexed 72 files including that symbol, but the governed context handed to the execution agent was 17 lines / 1035 bytes and contained neither PhpCodeParser nor getAstFromString - only the single in-scope class. The compiled Recall held four facts and no ranked fact at all. The cause was path ownership: WorkflowApproveCommand passes --map-search-index only when a file exists at ProjectLayout::mapSearchIndex() (.agent-loop/map/search.sqlite), but Dispatcher::resolveMapArgv() injected --root/--out/--index and never --database, so `agent-loop map search-index build` wrote to agent-map's own retired .agent-map/search.sqlite default. Approve then printed its ordinary success lines while compiling Recall with no ranked evidence.

evidence.summary: Same task, same scope, same ranking, same budget: with no index at the owned path the governed context was 17 lines / 1035 bytes with getAstFromString absent; after building the index at .agent-loop/map/search.sqlite it was 55 lines / 7496 bytes with getAstFromString and PhpCodeParser present. Frozen as tests/fixtures/real-upstream-adaptation/simple-php-code-parser-ast-context.json.

Asserts the index lands at ProjectLayout::mapSearchIndex() and not at .agent-map/search.sqlite, that an explicit --database still wins, and that the map namespace advertises the command. Removing the --database injection fails the first case.
Approve now warns and names the missing path and the command that builds it when ranked evidence is unavailable, and stays quiet when it is available.

hypothesis: The known Map to Recall to Context loss was read as a ranking or budget problem. It was neither: the evidence channel was never connected, because one derived path had a reader and no writer. A degradation that produces a smaller but well-formed context is indistinguishable from success unless the workflow says it happened.
validated_conclusion: A derived state path needs one owner for both reading and writing; ProjectLayout::mapSearchIndex() now governs both. When a decisive-evidence channel is unavailable, the governed workflow reports it rather than silently narrowing the context. The fix widened no search, changed no ranking, and raised no budget.
